description: This file contains the implementation of the CatalogViewModelService class, which is responsible for preparing catalog data specifically for the UI layer. It fetches catalog items, brands, and types from repositories, transforms data into view models, and provides methods to get filtered/select list items for UI components.

classes.name: CatalogViewModelService
classes.description: A UI-specific service that provides catalog data and view models for rendering views. It interacts with repositories to retrieve catalog items, brands, and types, and prepares data with UI considerations such as select lists and pagination.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Fetches a page of catalog items filtered by optional brand and type, constructs a ViewModel with pagination info and URLs for images.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Retrieves all catalog brands and returns them as a list of SelectListItem for use in UI dropdowns, including an 'All' option.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all catalog types and returns them as a list of SelectListItem for use in UI dropdowns, including an 'All' option.
